sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 4018 of 2023

Counsel for Applicant :- Arvind Kumar Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Arvind Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant, and Sri Manish Kumar
Pandey, learned Addl. Government Advocate.
2. By means of the instant application the applicant Constable Ashish Yadav S/o Indradev Yadav
seeks bail in Case Crime No. 294 of 2022, under section 376 Ipc and section 3/4, Protection of
Children from Sexual Offences (Pocso) Act, P.S. Lonar, District Hardoi.

sentences.text:
3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a first information report dated 22nd of July 2022 alleging that the applicant had made a false promise of marrying the informant's daughter and he made physical relations with her under the aforesaid false promise and that afterwards the applicant's brother made a demand of Fortuner vehicle as dowry.
4.

That in the statement of the victim recorded under section 161, CrPC she supported the FIR version and stated that the applicant used to come to her and that in November 2021 she had gone with the applicant to Ayodhya and stayed there with him in a room.

sentences.text: In the medico-legal examination report of the informant's daughter no injury has been reported on any part of her body and no definite opinion has been given about any sexual assault.

6. In the statement of the victim recorded under section 164, CrPC she has stated that the applicant was her boyfriend since 2019 and both of them had made physical relations on several occasions by mutual consent.
She further stated that subsequently the applicant declined to marry her and he is deferring marrying the victim by demanding dowry.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the facts that the alleged victim herself has stated that the applicant was her boyfriend and physical relations were made by mutual consent of both of them; that in the medico-legal examination report of the alleged victim no injury has been found on any part of her body; that the applicant has no criminal history and he is working in Police and there appears to be no reasonable probability of his running away from the process of law, in case he is enlarged on bail, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
